about_the_game:
🔥 Deals on Four Wheels

Have you ever dreamed of running your own dealership? In Deal On Four Wheels, you don’t just buy and sell vehicles—you customize them to meet the demands of the most demanding clients! From luxury models to high-performance sports cars, every deal could turn into a goldmine… if you play your cards right!

🚗 Diverse Clients, Unique Stories

Not all customers are the same! An influencer wants a flashy ride to impress their followers, a VIP seeks exclusivity, while an everyday client has more practical needs. Meet their demands, earn stellar reviews, and build your reputation in the industry!

🛠️ Upgrade, Customize, Progress!

The more deals you close, the more your name rises to the top! As you level up and gain reputation, you'll unlock new cars, upgrades, and exclusive customization options. Create one-of-a-kind vehicles and become the go-to dealer for those seeking the best!

🎲 Relax or Ruin? The Choice is Yours!

After a long day of wheeling and dealing, it’s time to unwind! Spend your earnings on luxury homes or kick back at the bar with a cold beer. And if you're feeling lucky, try your hand at blackjack… but be careful not to lose it all in one bad hand! Will you rise to the top as the ultimate car dealer, or will fortune turn against you? The road to success is in your hands!

content_descriptors.notes: The game includes some adult-oriented content strictly related to leisure activities, such as purchasing and consuming beer in a bar and playing blackjack. These elements are designed to enhance the management experience without introducing sensitive or inappropriate themes. There is no explicit violence, nudity, or sexual content, ensuring an accessible and enjoyable gaming environment for a broad audience.

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1050
  • DirectX: Version 11

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows (64-bit) 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVidia GeForce GTX 1060

short_description: Manage your office, buy and customize vehicles on demand for a diverse clientele, from influencers to car enthusiasts! The more clients you satisfy, the more money and reputation you earn. Unlock new suppliers, invest in properties, and unwind with a game of blackjack!
